faq.question: When do I pay the setup fee?
faq.answer: Only when your site goes live. I build it first, you see it, and only then do you pay the setup fee and I switch it on. You're not handing money over for something you haven't seen yet.

faq.question: What's the difference between Monthly, 6 months, and Rolling?
faq.answer: Monthly (3-month min) is the most popular — lower rate than rolling, short commitment. Six months saves you £10–20/month if you're ready to commit longer. Rolling is fully cancel-anytime with 30 days notice, but costs a little more per month. Setup fee is the same across all three.

faq.question: What happens after the minimum term?
faq.answer: It rolls month to month automatically. Cancel anytime after that with 30 days notice. Most clients stay because the SEO is working and they don't want to lose the momentum.

faq.question: Can I add the AI stuff to my existing website?
faq.answer: Yes. The AI and automation services work on any website, not just ones I've built. Just get in touch and I'll talk it through.

faq.question: I don't really understand AI. Is it still worth it?
faq.answer: That's exactly the right starting point. You don't need to understand how it works. Tell me what's taking up your time and I'll show you what's possible. No jargon.

faq.question: Do prices include VAT?
faq.answer: Pixova is not VAT registered, so no VAT is added to any prices shown. What you see is what you pay.
